nodes.label: Matheus Araripe Front-end & Design Portfolio
nodes.author: Matheus Araripe
nodes.rationale: Project identity: a personal portfolio positioned at the intersection of front-end development and graphic design, targeted at a Brazilian-Portuguese audience (lang="pt-BR").

nodes.label: SEO and Open Graph Metadata
nodes.rationale: Title, description and og:* tags are duplicated in the static HTML head rather than injected at runtime, so crawlers and social-link unfurlers that do not execute JavaScript still see the portfolio's identity. Content is authored in pt-BR to match the document lang.

nodes.label: SVG favicon and white theme-color
nodes.rationale: An SVG favicon scales to any density without multiple raster assets; theme-color is pinned to #ffffff, implying a light-only visual identity rather than a dark-mode-aware chrome.

nodes.label: ESLint Configuration Expansion
nodes.rationale: The template ships with only 'some ESLint rules' and plain JavaScript. For production applications the documented recommendation is to migrate to TypeScript with type-aware lint rules, because type information catches a class of defects that syntactic lint rules cannot. The JS-only default is a deliberate simplicity/onboarding trade-off, not an endorsement.

nodes.label: React Compiler (disabled)
nodes.rationale: The React Compiler is deliberately NOT enabled on this template because of its measured impact on dev and build performance. Trade-off: give up automatic memoization/optimization in exchange for faster iteration cycles; opt-in is left to the consumer of the template.
